verses.1: The LORD said to Moses, "Now you will see what I am about to do to Pharaoh. For with a strong hand I will send them out, and with a strong hand I will drive them from his land."
verses.2: God spoke to Moses and said to him, "I am the LORD."
verses.3: "I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as the God of might, but my name the LORD I did not make known to them."
verses.4: "And I established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they were sojourners, the land they had dwelled in."
verses.5: "And I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are oppressing, and I have remembered my covenant."
verses.6: "Therefore say to the Israelites, 'I am the LORD. I will bring you out from under the burdens of Egypt and rescue you from their service. And I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with great judgments.'"
verses.7: "I will take you to be my people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who is bringing you out from under the burdens of Egypt."
verses.8: "And I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD.'"
verses.9: Moses spoke to the Israelites, but they did not listen to Moses because of shortness of breath and hard service.
verses.10: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.11: "Go and speak to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and let the Israelites go out of his land."
verses.12: Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, "Indeed, the Israelites did not listen to me. How then will Pharaoh listen to me, and I am a man of uncircumcised lips?"
verses.13: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and commanded them concerning the Israelites and Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
verses.14: These are the heads of the paternal families: the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These are the families of Reuben.
verses.15: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of the Canaanite woman. These are the families of Simeon.
verses.16: And these are the names of the sons of Levi, according to their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. The years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven.
verses.17: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, by their families.
verses.18: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. The years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three.
verses.19: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites, according to their generations.
verses.20: Amram took Yochebed, his aunt, as his wife, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven.
verses.21: The sons of Izhar: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.22: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.23: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, his sister-in-law, as his wife, and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.24: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These are the families of the Korahites.
verses.25: Eleazar, the son of Aaron, took a daughter of Putiel as his wife, and she bore him Phinehas. These are the leaders of the Levite families, according to their families.
verses.26: It is Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, "Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt, by their companies."
verses.27: They are the ones who spoke to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of Egypt. These are Moses and Aaron.
verses.28: Now it came to pass on the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt.
verses.29: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, "I am the LORD. Speak to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, all that I am telling you."
verses.30: Moses said before the LORD, "Indeed, I am a man of uncircumcised lips. How will Pharaoh listen to me?"

notes:
Notes
- v. 3: "I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as the God of might" – The Hebrew text uses the phrase "El Shaddai," which is translated here as "God of might" to reflect the common interpretation of the term as a name or title of God, rather than a literal translation.
- v. 12: "I am a man of uncircumcised lips" – The phrase "aral sifatayim" is translated as "uncircumcised lips" to reflect the idiomatic expression for speaking poorly or being hesitant to speak.

[1] The LORD said to Moses, "Now you will see what I am about to do to Pharaoh. For with a strong hand I will send them out, and with a strong hand I will drive them from his land."

[2] God spoke to Moses and said to him, "I am the LORD."

[3] "I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as the God of might, but my name the LORD I did not make known to them."

[4] "And I established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they were sojourners, the land they had dwelled in."

[5] "And I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are oppressing, and I have remembered my covenant."

[6] "Therefore say to the Israelites, 'I am the LORD. I will bring you out from under the burdens of Egypt and rescue you from their service. And I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with great judgments.'"

[7] "I will take you to be my people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who is bringing you out from under the burdens of Egypt."

[8] "And I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD.'"

[9] Moses spoke to the Israelites, but they did not listen to Moses because of shortness of breath and hard service.

[10] The LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

[11] "Go and speak to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and let the Israelites go out of his land."

[12] Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, "Indeed, the Israelites did not listen to me. How then will Pharaoh listen to me, and I am a man of uncircumcised lips?"

[13] The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and commanded them concerning the Israelites and Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.

[14] These are the heads of the paternal families: the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These are the families of Reuben.

[15] And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of the Canaanite woman. These are the families of Simeon.

[16] And these are the names of the sons of Levi, according to their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. The years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven.

[17] The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, by their families.

[18] The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. The years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three.

[19] The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites, according to their generations.

[20] Amram took Yochebed, his aunt, as his wife, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven.

[21] The sons of Izhar: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.

[22] The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

[23] Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, his sister-in-law, as his wife, and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

[24] The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These are the families of the Korahites.

[25] Eleazar, the son of Aaron, took a daughter of Putiel as his wife, and she bore him Phinehas. These are the leaders of the Levite families, according to their families.

[26] It is Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, "Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt, by their companies."

[27] They are the ones who spoke to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of Egypt. These are Moses and Aaron.

[28] Now it came to pass on the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt.

[29] The LORD spoke to Moses, saying, "I am the LORD. Speak to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, all that I am telling you."

[30] Moses said before the LORD, "Indeed, I am a man of uncircumcised lips. How will Pharaoh listen to me?"
